newsitem.title: UK: UK shares set new record as rate hike fears fade.
newsitem.headline: UK shares set new record as rate hike fears fade.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index finished at a record high for the fifth time this year, lifted by weaker sterling and a growing belief that British base rates would remain steady for the foreseeable future .

The pound's retreat from near five-year highs against the German mark was seen as positive for overseas earners and exporters while recent economic data has convinced many participants that UK rates may not rise until the summer.
"The theme of today has been sterling," one dealer said. "It's helped the dollar earners which has pushed the market higher." The FTSE 100 closed 52.4 higher at 4,271.5.
